questions.prompt: Why must local variables captured by a Java lambda expression be `final` or 'effectively final'?

options.text: Java captures local variables by value copy (not mutable closure box), so mutating a local variable would cause confusing divergence

questions.prompt: What does `flatMap` do in a Java `Stream`?

questions.prompt: How do `Comparable<T>` and `Comparator<T>` differ?

options.text: `Comparable` defines a class's natural ordering (`compareTo`), while `Comparator` defines external/multiple ordering strategies (`Comparator.comparing(User::age)`)

questions.prompt: What happens if `Comparator.comparingInt(User::age)` is used in `TreeSet` when two distinct `User`s have the same `age`?

options.text: `TreeSet` uses `compare == 0` for equality, so the second `User` is treated as a duplicate and NOT inserted!
